Market today: The market's got mixed signals. Nvidia's massive buyback is a huge positive for tech, but rising Treasury yields are putting pressure on growth stocks, which is a headwind for your concentrated tech book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-39.54%) and SPAL (-35.39%) are your biggest concerns. Both are leveraged ETFs, decaying assets, and deep in the red. Margin amplifies these drops, so these need immediate attention.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Treasury yields; continued rises will hurt your tech positions. Also, watch how NVDA reacts to its buyback news, as it can influence the broader chip sector.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your leveraged losers while monitoring broader market headwinds for tech.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting. This leveraged ETF is down nearly 40% and decays, making recovery tough, especially on margin.
SPAL: Review your stop at 21.38. This leveraged ETF is also down significantly and decays; manage risk aggressively.
SMH: Your scanner shows an "ACCUMULATE" setup (entry 592.13-591.54, stop 590.13). If you want to add to your existing position, this could be a spot.
